affected_subject.reason: Identifies L2TokenReceiverV2::increaseLiquidityCurrentRange and its Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager interaction.

trigger_or_action.reason: Calling increaseLiquidityCurrentRange passes block.timestamp as the deadline argument.

direct_effect.reason: Deadline check becomes a no-op, allowing delayed transactions to be executed later at submitter's disadvantage.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected deadline to bound execution time versus actual no-op comparison of block.timestamp to itself gives a temporal safety relation.

summary: Fragments identify the affected function, the block.timestamp deadline trigger, the no-op deadline effect enabling delayed execution, and the temporal safety relation.
